protocol.requestId: Stable key from platform + tenant/team + channel + source message ID; never a mutable title or generated timestamp.
protocol.deliveryRule: Mark delivered only when the channel receipt explicitly confirms delivery to the allowed destination. An accepted/reported_sent response is send_accepted, not delivery or read proof.
protocol.uncertainRule: If an outbound call might have succeeded but lacks a usable receipt, mark send_uncertain and ask the owner to reconcile before retrying.
protocol.staleClaimRule: An expired claim is not permission to rerun an action; reconcile action and delivery evidence before an owner-authorized recovery.
